method_notes: Totals use a separate dimensionless byProperty request.
Page/query groups combine host variants by URL path; raw variants retained.
Page totals and property totals have different aggregation rules.
Query rows omit anonymized terms and API may return only top rows.
Opportunity filters are a review screen, not a predicted traffic uplift.
Stored URL inspections are not a fresh live indexing test.
No post-release performance gain is claimed.

limitations: 11 indexing inspections only, not a sitewide index count.
Representative tool tests in Chromium, not every format/browser/input.
No GA4 conversion data, controlled Google SERP overlap or complete backlink profile.
Application code unchanged during this audit; existing local fixes remain pending deployment.

detailed_actions.title: Make advertised converter outputs valid
detailed_actions.observation: Live AVIF and BMP downloads contain PNG bytes and MIME despite .avif/.bmp filenames. See tool-quality.md for other decoder results.
detailed_actions.recommendation: Use verified encoders or disable unsupported outputs with a clear message. Confirm MIME and extension from the actual encoded blob, then align all conversion landing-page claims.
detailed_actions.depends_on: None; before promoting converters or linking the orphan AVIF page.
detailed_actions.acceptance: For each advertised format, a known input exports a matching signature/MIME/extension and decodes in two independent readers. Transparency/dimensions follow documented behavior.
detailed_actions.failed_if: Any advertised output is mislabeled, fails decoding, or becomes a silent PNG fallback.
detailed_actions.indicator: Format regression pass rate and conversion error reports.
detailed_actions.effort: 1-3 days, longer if new encoders are needed

detailed_actions.depends_on: None; review code and visible claims together.
detailed_actions.acceptance: Recompressing after a format/quality/target change produces the new requested result. Output is at/below the target or clearly reports failure, with resulting dimensions and transparency shown.
detailed_actions.failed_if: Old bytes remain after changed settings, target is exceeded without warning, or PNG is silently represented as lossless while transcoded.
detailed_actions.indicator: Changed-setting and target-size regression results, successful download rate.

detailed_actions.acceptance: Known marked test images crop to the selected source region without unintended blank space, stretching or enlargement. Export dimensions match the documented mode on desktop and mobile.
detailed_actions.failed_if: Display size still controls an undocumented output resize or selected content/bounds differ from the download.
detailed_actions.indicator: Source-region and dimension regression checks; crop-related error reports.
